svg.text: FlowGrid — Engineering Handoff & Measured QA Audit (v2)
CSS design tokens, individual measured contrast ratios (no certified claims), performance budgets, and client questionnaire
01. Core Design Tokens & CSS Custom Properties
Primary brand anchor, desktop headers, primary CTA
Global canvas background, calm warm paper feel
Subtitles, concept badges, focus rings, phase numbers
Secondary buttons, badge backing, subtle dividers
High-contrast readable body text (4.82:1 on Parchment)

text.tspan: • Grid: 12 Columns | Max-width: 1320px | Gutters: 32px | Side Margins: 60px.
• Primary content columns: 580px card widths in 2-column layouts; 380px cards
in 3-column layouts.
• Grid: 4 Columns | Full-width cards: 350px | Gutters: 16px | Side Margins:
20px.
• Touch Target Standard: All clickable buttons, pills, and inputs minimum 44px
height (strictly implemented as 48px).

svg.text: 2. CRITICAL GOVERNANCE: Items Pending Code Implementation Verification

text.tspan: The delivered design system provides verified high-contrast visual tokens and
touch targets. However, the design CANNOT be claimed as 'WCAG 2.2 AA Certified'
because true compliance requires interactive browser execution of full user
journeys:
• Keyboard Tab Sequence (2.1.1): Must be implemented in semantic HTML with
logical tabIndex order.
• Screen Reader Tree (4.1.2): ARIA labels (e.g., aria-expanded on mobile
hamburger) must be wired in frontend.
• User Text Spacing (1.4.12): Avoidance of clipping when users apply custom CSS
line-height/letter-spacing in browser.
• Responsive Reflow (1.4.10): Testing 400% zoom without horizontal scrolling on
1280px browser viewport.
• Reduced Motion (2.3.3): Active verification of CSS @media (prefers-reduced-
motion: reduce) in target browsers.

svg.text: RULE: All references to 'certified' have been removed from customer and internal documents.
03. Studio Owner Business Fact Verification Checklist (8 Actionable Inquiries)
Q1. Legal Entity & Trade License Registration

text.tspan: What is the registered trade license name, Dhaka City Corporation zone number,
and official TIN/BIN for FlowGrid Studio? Current design uses placeholder
'FlowGrid Studio Mirpur 12'.

svg.text: Q2. Physical Studio Road Address & Visiting Policy

text.tspan: What is the exact holding number, road number, and block in Mirpur 12? Does the
studio accept walk-in client visits, or is access by appointment only following
initial phone screening?

svg.text: Q3. Official Telephone & WhatsApp Business Routing

text.tspan: Please provide the active mobile number dedicated to customer consultations.
Will enquiries route to a single principal architect or a designated studio
client manager?

svg.text: Q4. Architectural Fee Structure & Pricing Model

text.tspan: How does FlowGrid quote clients? Is it a fixed design fee per square foot
(BDT/sft), a percentage of total project execution cost (e.g. 10-15%), or a
tiered lump-sum consultation retainer?

svg.text: Q5. Scope Boundaries: Joinery vs Civil Construction

text.tspan: Does FlowGrid perform civil demolition, masonry, and sanitary plumbing directly,
or does the studio provide joinery design, cabinetry fabrication, and
supervision of client-appointed contractors?

svg.text: Q6. Sister Entity Boundary: Rumi's Fashionable House

text.tspan: Are you comfortable with the current footer and studio narrative that positions
Rumi's lifestyle channel strictly as founder domestic context, without implying
architectural credentials?

svg.text: Q7. Commercial Boundary: Onekta Product Transition

text.tspan: Please confirm that FlowGrid's website will carry zero retail product listings
or e-commerce checkouts for appliances, and will solely feature an outbound link
to Onekta Product's separate store.

svg.text: Q8. Real Project Photography & Client Consent

text.tspan: Do you have signed client photography release forms for previously completed
Dhaka apartments, or should FlowGrid continue to showcase clearly disclosed
conceptual spatial studies?

svg.text: Front-End Engineering Core Web Vitals Budget Targets

text.tspan: Preload hero image in <head>, convert all architectural photography to
AVIF/WebP formats under 120KB per hero frame.
Enforce explicit aspect-ratio attributes on all image and card frames. Reserve
header and banner heights to prevent layout jitter.
Zero main-thread blocking JavaScript on form interactions. Mobile menu toggle
executed via lightweight CSS transform classes.
